candidates.title: Heart Rent Notice
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu lovingly demands rent from Zuv because he has been living in her heart for too long.
candidates.emotional_truth: Couples tease each other for being emotionally permanent fixtures in each other's lives.
candidates.relatable_trigger: The mock-serious demand people make when affection has become routine.
candidates.visual_evidence: Aachu holds a tiny open wallet or handwritten rent note while Zuv smiles, caught and adored.

candidates.title: Security Deposit
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu asks Zuv for a security deposit before he takes permanent residence in her heart.
candidates.emotional_truth: A playful way of admitting commitment without becoming too sincere.
candidates.relatable_trigger: Couples joking about rent, bills, and emotional labor.
candidates.visual_evidence: A tiny receipt book and Zuv pretending to search his pockets.

rejected_patterns: Zuv asking Aachu, because the creator corrected the direction.
A literal landlord/renter setup, because it becomes too staged.
A quote-card-only illustration, because it loses lived-in couple behavior.
risk_notes: Keep Aachu's expression playful, not scolding.
Keep Zuv delighted, not embarrassed or diminished.
